message: Designer is checking the furniture layout

The sage-green sofa suits the room’s earthy palette: warm cream walls, a beige rug, walnut and oak furniture, terracotta seating and brass accents. Its muted green adds gentle contrast without feeling harsh.

I can’t confirm the floor match directly: no render or floor finish is included here. If it’s warm-toned wood, sage would generally complement it well.

One optional small improvement: a slightly warmer cream rug could soften the transition between sofa and floor. Nothing has been changed.
